# aoss_primary_vlan (Resource)

Manages the primary VLAN.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "aoss_primary_vlan" "this" {
  vlan_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vlan_id` (Number) The primary VLAN identifier.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
